thread:
Elaine K.: quick follow-up thread for the security/privacy segment from todays all-hands. i'll distill the key questions leadership flagged and we can reply with short updates. main topics: SOC2/ISO scope, private deployments (network & data residency), audit logging/exports, and KMS/BYOK. please reply inline if you own something.

Sanjay R.: brief from execs: we need concrete owners + short timelines. they want a one-pager for customers explaining what 'private' gives you vs dedicated. also asked: can we support customer-held archives for long-tail retention?

Devon M.: SOC2/ISO notes:
- SOC2: aiming to complete readiness cycle by end of Q2, formal audit window Q3.
- ISO27001: scoping in Q2, certification effort will run in parallel with SOC2 evidence collection.
- Owner request: i can take infra controls; need app/security owner (Rina?) and ops owner (Tom?).

Rina S.: I can own app/security controls. will set up a control mapping doc today and tag owners.

Tom H.: Ops will own runbooks + evidence exports. simple export command i'll drop here for ops engineers:
```
# export consolidated audit trail to S3
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/console-audit/2026-06/ s3://customer-evidence-bucket/allhands-18405/ --recursive --storage-class STANDARD_IA
```
I'll add a version that streams directly to customer buckets (with IAM role) in the runbook.

Legal - Priya: question on data residency: can archival exports be sent to customer-owned EU buckets for EU customers? also need sample contract language for audit data access.

Devon M.: yes for EU customers we can export to customer-owned EU S3; need onboarding step to verify bucket, role, and encryption settings. template contract language: "Customer-managed archival export: customer will provide destination bucket ARN and IAM role; Redwood will transfer audit artifacts per agreed retention schedule." i'll share a draft.

SecurityTeamBot: automated note: starting standardized tag rollout for audit events. new tags: audit.env, audit.correlation. will attach schema to the runbook.

Elaine K.: KMS/BYOK question from the audience: what support do we have for customer keys + HSM?

Devon M.: current plan:
- Phase 1 (Q2 pilot): BYOK using customer-managed KMS keys (AWS KMS) with envelope encryption. rotation API v1 available for pilot.
- Phase 2 (Q3): HSM-backed BYOK (external HSM integration) and KMS key import for on-prem.
- Default behavior: Redwood-managed keys for hosted customers; enterprise contracts can opt into BYOK.

Rina S.: technical note: we will require a grant-based cross-account role for customers to allow writes to customer buckets and to allow Redwood to use customer KMS for encryption. docs + terraform example incoming.

Tom H.: networking for private deployments: requirements checklist: customer CIDR ranges, peering/privatelink choice, egress allowlist to control-plane endpoints (list to be published), and optional Direct Connect. pilot in Q3, GA Q4.

Sanjay R.: product ask: can we produce a short 'what private gives you' summary + short customer-facing checklist? Product team to draft by next week.

Elaine K.: action items captured:
- Devon: SOC2 control mapping + contract template for customer exports (due 2026-05-10)
- Rina: app/security control doc + tagging schema (due 2026-04-30)
- Tom: runbook + export scripts + terraform example for customer buckets (due 2026-05-07)
- Product: customer one-pager for private vs dedicated (due 2026-04-15)

OpsBot: created ticket #SEC-1984 (SOC2 readiness) and linked docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/controls and https://docs.redwood.ai/private/onboarding.

SecurityTeamBot: reminder: we'll run a dry-evidence pull next month to validate the export flow. volunteers for tabletop: @Devon M., @Tom H., @Rina S.

Elaine K.: thanks all. add any missed follow-ups here and i'll fold into the all-hands notes. :white_check_mark:
